Technology Commons is a living collection of course material, projects, tools, and references for secondary-school technology education.
:::

## What is here

The first courses are TAS2O Exploring Technologies, TEJ3M and TEJ4M Computer Engineering Technology, and TTJ3C and TTJ4C Transportation Technology.

The material is designed first for students who need to know what they are doing next, while remaining useful to educators who want to reuse, adapt, or extend the work.

## How the courses work

Projects, documentation, iteration, and evidence of learning are emphasized throughout. The NICE Design Process provides a shared structure for identifying needs, investigating, creating, communicating, and evaluating.

This site will grow with the courses rather than waiting for every page and tool to be finished before it is useful.
